text:
Alex Nguyen: FYI support ticket ACME-892: sudden latency spike for EU customers — p50 ~400ms -> p99 ~2s. Customer traces show egress to ap-southeast even though client region header is eu-west-1.
Maria Lopez: Ticket link? request id?
Alex Nguyen: Request id x-request-id=abc123. Customer trace id trc-9001. Snippet from their traceroute:
```
traceroute to api.redwood.ai (35.189.64.21), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1 ...
 6  35.189.64.21  180.2 ms  182.0 ms  179.9 ms  <-- ap-southeast egress
```
Alex Nguyen: They also sent curl that hits apac IP even with region header. Header in request: `x-rw-region: eu-west-1`.
Support Ana: I pulled our access logs for x-request-id=abc123 — server logs show route decision: chosen_region=ap-southeast-1, fallback_reason=capacity_threshold. FWIW capacity on eu-west pool spiked to 96% at the time.
SRE Jordan: I'm seeing a suspicious route advertisement from our transit partner during the spike window, AS path shows detour via apac transit. Also DNS for edgepool.example resolved to an apac IP due to weight calc.
Maria Lopez: Did any model rollouts happen that could change shard locality or fallback rules?
eng-runtime-bot: Model rollout event: variant 1.4.2 rolled to edge pools at 2024-12-01T02:34Z. Config change: fallback_policy.min_capacity_percent=95 -> 95.
Alex Nguyen: Repro steps I've asked customer to run (curl):
```
curl -v "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "x-rw-region: eu-west-1" \
  -H "x-request-id: abc123" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
SRE Jordan: Quick mitigations: 1) temporarily raise eu-west pool capacity reserve / reduce fallback aggressiveness; 2) tweak edge DNS weight to prefer eu pool; 3) withdraw bad BGP path with partner. I'll open a network ticket.
Support Ana: Customer provided tcpdump showing SYNs to 35.189.64.21 (apac). They also included client source IP 203.0.113.47. Please check NAT mapping and egress translation.
Maria Lopez: I'll correlate our LB logs with that src IP and the request id, and share exact timestamps. ETA EOD.
Alex Nguyen: Marking P1 since this affects multiple customers in EU. Can oncall please prioritize? :warning:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-3119 created and assigned to oncall.
Alex Nguyen: Assigning to SRE Jordan and eng-runtime for follow-up. Please post actions here and a short RCA draft once we have root cause.
SRE Jordan: Acknowledged, starting network forensic now.
Maria Lopez: Thanks — I'll update the customer with next steps and ask them to retry with `x-prefer-local: true` for now.
